description.value: The Snowbird is a collection of slope-side, multi-level townhomes in Whistler's Blackcomb Benchlands, offering 2–4 bedroom units sleeping up to 10 people. Each unit includes a full kitchen, gas fireplace, in-suite laundry, private deck, and access to a shared outdoor hot tub. A free shuttle to Whistler Village is provided, and the property sits steps from ski-in/ski-out access and close to Whistler's extensive summer mountain biking trail network.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is 'The Snowbird', a set of multi-level townhomes on Blackcomb Benchlands managed by Whiski Jack Resorts; the OSM name 'Snowbird Ski & Summer Resort' diverges from the website's consistent branding of 'The Snowbird'. Facilities explicitly listed include In Suite Laundry and Complimentary WIFI; no bike storage, drying area, or cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content. Booking details with dates extending to 2027 confirm the property is actively operating.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the property as 'Snowbird Ski & Summer Resort' but the website consistently uses 'The Snowbird' (managed by Whiski Jack Resorts).
OSM has no phone number; phone sourced from website only (toll-free 1-844-957-6967, local 604-962-0220).
OSM address (4865 Painted Cliff Road) not explicitly confirmed on the website's Snowbird page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively bookable vacation rental property in Whistler with a well-maintained website and bookings through 2027; a useful base for cyclists visiting the area.
enrichment_extras.notes: Whiski Jack Resorts' website navigation includes a 'Ski, Board & Bike Rentals' section, suggesting rental services may be available through the resort management company, though it is not confirmed as on-site at The Snowbird specifically.
